standard_prerequisites: the base change setup for pairs (A1, I1) to (A2, I2) of Noetherian adic rings (remark-base-change) with B1 in the completion class (equation-C-prime) and B2 its base change
the base change map for naive cotangent complexes (lemma-NL-base-change): a map NL_{B1/A1} tensor B2 B1 to NL_{B2/A2} inducing an isomorphism on H^0 and a surjection on H^{-1}

the More on Algebra lemma transferring vanishing of a self-map of a two-term complex under a map that is an isomorphism on H^0 and a surjection on H^{-1} (more-algebra-lemma-two-term-surjection-map-zero)
core_obligations: If multiplication by f1 in B1 on NL^wedge_{B1/A1} is zero in D(B1), then multiplication by the image f2 in B2 on NL^wedge_{B2/A2} is zero in D(B2).
The proof combines the NL base change map with the two-term transfer lemma.
proof_roadmap: Invoke lemma-NL-base-change for the comparison map on naive cotangent complexes.
Apply the two-term surjection lemma to transfer vanishing of multiplication by f1 to f2.
difficulty_reason: H2: a one-lemma transfer of vanishing along the base change map of cotangent complexes.
